::: {#def-data-set}

#### Data set

A **data set** is a finite collection of $\nobs$ labelled observations,
that is, $\nobs$ pairs $(\vpredvar_i, \outvar_i)$, each an input $\vpredvar_i$ with its outcome $\outvar_i$:

$$
\dataset \eqdef \set{(\vpredvar_i, \outvar_i) : i = 1, \ldots, \nobs} .
$$ {#eq-data-set}

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#rem-data-set-subsets}

#### The sets we split a data set into

We divide a [data set](#def-data-set) into subsets, each with its own job.
"Set" in the names training set, validation set and test set is short for "subset of the data set".

:::
